# scaling_inbound_integration (Resource)

Manages the ordered Routing Selectors on an existing inbound integration. The integration itself is provisioned out-of-band (for example by connecting a source in the UI); this resource owns only its selectors, which are replaced wholesale on every apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "scaling_routing_policy" "critical" {
  name = "Critical Routing"

  rule {
    severity = "critical"
    outcome  = "incident"
  }
  rule {
    severity = "high"
    outcome  = "incident"
  }
  rule {
    severity = "medium"
    outcome  = "notification"
  }
  rule {
    severity = "low"
    outcome  = "drop"
  }
}

resource "scaling_routing_policy" "low_noise" {
  name = "Low Noise Routing"

  rule {
    severity = "critical"
    outcome  = "notification"
  }
  rule {
    severity = "high"
    outcome  = "notification"
  }
  rule {
    severity = "medium"
    outcome  = "drop"
  }
  rule {
    severity = "low"
    outcome  = "drop"
  }
}

# The inbound integration itself is provisioned out-of-band (for example by
# connecting a source in the UI). This resource owns only its ordered Routing
# Selectors: the first row whose matchers all match an alert wins, so order is
# significant. A miss falls through to the integration's default policy.
resource "scaling_inbound_integration" "datadog" {
  integration_id = "int_01h9xyz"

  selector {
    matcher {
      key   = "service"
      value = "payments"
    }
    matcher {
      key   = "env"
      value = "prod"
    }
    routing_policy_id = scaling_routing_policy.critical.id
  }

  selector {
    matcher {
      key   = "env"
      value = "staging"
    }
    routing_policy_id = scaling_routing_policy.low_noise.id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_id` (String) ID of the existing inbound integration whose selectors this resource manages.

### Optional

- `selector` (Block List) Ordered Routing Selector rows. The first row whose matchers all match an alert chooses its routing_policy_id; a miss falls through to routing_policy_id or the org default. Order is significant. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--selector))

### Read-Only

- `component_id` (String) Component this integration's alerts resolve to.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the inbound integration (equal to integration_id).
- `name` (String) Display name of the inbound integration.
- `org_id` (String) Organization that owns this integration.
- `routing_policy_id` (String) Routing policy override applied when no selector row matches. Null means the org default policy.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 last-update timestamp.

<a id="nestedblock--selector"></a>
### Nested Schema for `selector`

Required:

- `routing_policy_id` (String) Routing policy this row selects when its matchers all match.

Optional:

- `matcher` (Block List) Attribute equality matchers, ANDed together. Severity is never a matcher. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--selector--matcher))

<a id="nestedblock--selector--matcher"></a>
### Nested Schema for `selector.matcher`

Required:

- `key` (String) Declared attribute key to match on.
- `value` (String) Value the attribute must equal (case-insensitively).
